The Developer's proactive removal of all 11 dead imports (vs. 6 specified) is the correct approach when enabling a compile-time guard. Fixing all issues surfaced by the new flag in a single commit avoids a follow-up cleanup WP and leaves the codebase in a fully-clean state. This pattern should be the default whenever a new strict compiler flag is enabled.
